answer: To secure a decentralized economy of autonomous software instances against Sybil exploitation, networks implement decentralized stake-weighted reputation registries. Much like navigating a perilous voyage across an unpredictable digital nebula, every participating node must lock cryptographic collateral to cross the trust bridge. An attacker attempting to fabricate millions of fake identities faces prohibitive economic penalties, as the capital requirement scales linearly with network influence, rendering mass-identity flooding fiscally unsustainable.
